# Cat and Dog Hospital of Portland

> A comprehensive AAFP Cat Friendly Practice and Fear Free certified veterinary clinic in Portland, Oregon offering preventative care, emergency services, diagnostics, dental care, grooming, and acupuncture for cats and dogs.

Cat and Dog Hospital of Portland is a full-service veterinary clinic located in Portland, Oregon, specializing in both feline and canine care with certified veterinarians, technicians, and assistants. The hospital emphasizes low-stress, fear-free veterinary practices and maintains AAFP certification for cat-friendly care.

## Key Topics

- AAFP Cat Friendly Practice
- Fear Free Certified
- Portland, Oregon

## Core Services

- [Veterinary Services](https://catanddogvet.com/veterinary-services): Overview of comprehensive veterinary services and diagnostics
- [Preventative Pet Health](https://catanddogvet.com/preventative-pet-health): Preventative care including vaccines, exams, and parasite protection
- [Sick Pet Care](https://catanddogvet.com/sick-pet-care): Sick pet care and emergency referral services in Portland
- [Emergency Services](https://catanddogvet.com/emergency): Emergency services and animal health offerings at Cat and Dog Hospital
- [Veterinary Diagnostics](https://catanddogvet.com/veterinary-diagnostics): Diagnostic testing, radiology, ultrasound, and laboratory services
- [Animal Dental Clinic](https://catanddogvet.com/animal-dental-services): Dental cleaning and oral disease prevention for cats and dogs
- [Veterinary Acupuncture](https://catanddogvet.com/acupuncture): Veterinary acupuncture and pain management by Dr. Woodside
